title: phaenopyrum coccineum
intro: Phaenopyrum coccineum, commonly known as the Chinese rice grass or Red rice grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of P. coccineum include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The plant is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, and is also considered to have potential therapeutic applications in the management of cancer and cardiovascular diseases.
